'''May 2001 Madrid tournament (19 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 19 May 2001. [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2336">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-madrid-ithor-05-19-01d2336/ madrid-ithor-05-19-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 21 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-madrid-ithor-05-19-01d2336/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]]
